prompts.Header: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game UI background texture, a wide landscape banner for a premium fantasy gathering addon. Panoramic misty pine forest and jagged mountains under a luminous teal dusk, small ancient watchtower on far RIGHT, tiny warm gold lights. Painterly detailed World of Warcraft-like hand painted fantasy material, restrained and beautiful. Dark navy teal palette, touches of antique gold. LEFT two thirds mostly dark atmospheric negative space for text overlaid in code. No words, no letters, no UI controls, no frames, no logo, no watermark. Wide 3:1 composition. Deliver usable flat texture.
prompts.Emblem: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI emblem for a premium fantasy gathering addon: one magnificent small polished antique gold compass medallion combining a delicate emerald leaf and faceted turquoise mineral at center. Bold readable silhouette with elegant bevels, rich hand-painted fantasy game icon quality. Centered fills 80% square canvas. Subtle gold patina, restrained teal glow. Truly transparent background outside medallion, no text, no letters, no other objects, no external shadow.
prompts.Material: Use case: stylized-concept. Production flat game UI panel material texture, full square canvas. Very dark midnight blue slate and leather with extremely subtle engraved cartographic contour lines and softly mottled pigment, tasteful artisanal fantasy game material. Almost black navy teal, very low contrast so bright text is legible. No borders, no medallions, no lettering, no objects, no lights, no frame, no interface. Uniform quiet material throughout entire canvas.
prompts.Professions: Use case: stylized-concept. One production sprite atlas texture for fantasy game professions. Exact square 2 by 2 equal grid with FOUR isolated square medallion icons, one centered in each quadrant, generous padding within each cell. Top-left: rich copper and turquoise ore crystal cluster. Top-right: luminous emerald medicinal leaf sprig. Bottom-left: folded warm russet brown leather hide. Bottom-right: elegant golden navigation compass rose with cyan center. Same polished antique bronze circular thin rim for all four, hand painted fantasy game inventory artwork, chunky silhouettes readable at 32 pixels, jewel quality lighting. Each icon fits in its quadrant without touching another. Actual transparent background between and outside medallions. No words or labels, no grid lines, no text, no fake transparency checkerboard.

geometry: Hollow map pins and arrows authored as simple geometry; all interactive controls and text authored in Lua.
